## Resulting behavior

Describe the problem, change and affected module. Keep one bounded task per PR.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Separate source, browser, Android emulator and physical-device checks. Identify APK/commit hashes where relevant. State checks not run and any unresolved failures.

## Source and continuation

Record assumptions/document provenance affected. Update docs/STATUS.md and docs/TASKS.md with the next concrete task. Do not include signing keys, credentials or original private documents.
